Lemma 4

Lemma 4 (bounded amplification (OpenAI 2026, Lemma 3.1); see @BBHT1998 and @BHMT2002). *Let A prepare a state with a success flag, with success probability p. For 0<γ≤1/2 and 0<η<1/2 there is a procedure making O(γ⁻¹/2log(1/η)) calls to A and A⁻¹ on every branch, for every p, that either reports failure or produces a successful outcome. Lemma 5

Lemma 5 (OpenAI (OpenAI 2026, Lemma 4.1); @Shaltiel2003; @Drucker2012). *Let P be a partial function and μ a distribution on its domain such that every deterministic algorithm making at most L queries computes P under μ with probability at most β.
